label: Objectives
subgoals: Target the fault site at the opposite value until the fault is activated
Pick a D-frontier gate and set an X input to its non-controlling value
Backtrack when no X-path links the frontier to an output

label: Backtrace
subgoals: Invert the required value through NAND, NOR and NOT gates
Follow the easiest input when one controlling input suffices
Follow the hardest input when every input needs the non-controlling value

label: Implication and backtracking
subgoals: Simulate the circuit after each primary input decision
Flip the most recent untried decision on failure
Report a test when an output carries D or D-bar
